Class ErrorMessage

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am31.am31.network.messages.Message
it.polimi.ingsw.am31.am31.network.messages.errorMessage.ErrorMessage
public class ErrorMessage extends Message
Server-to-client error notification. Carries an ErrorCode and a string message. Since the client-side handling of the messages is typically a prompt on the screen and does not interfere with local state, there is not a hierarchy of ErrorMessage, but the handling is based on the ErrorCode.
